summary: Run now works reliably for the tenant list, and removed admins, groups and delegations no longer clutter your lists.

fixes.title: Run now works for the tenant list
fixes.text: Refreshing the tenant list with Run now no longer fails or keeps a shorter list of Azure scopes. A partly refused read keeps the fuller list you already had.

fixes.title: Removed items are hidden in lists
fixes.text: Deleted admins, retired groups and removed delegations no longer show in the record lists. A Show removed link brings them into view when you need them.

fixes.title: Deleted accounts show their real state
fixes.text: After Delete account, the admin shows Marked for deletion until PIM Manager has deleted it. The account is deleted only after its group memberships are removed.

fixes.title: Fewer failed runs from short faults
fixes.text: PIM Manager retries its Azure sign-in a few times before a run fails, and the coverage report is always saved.
